method_scope.purpose: estimate the value ceiling before training/pinning a semantic predictor

variant_definitions.scale_all: universal robust scale estimated from all valid BIM hits
variant_definitions.scale_core: robust scale estimated only from oracle BIM-supported semantic classes
variant_definitions.semantic_apply_gate: geometry-only local field, applied only on oracle BIM-supported semantic classes
variant_definitions.semantic_source_gate: local field sourced and applied only on oracle BIM-supported semantic classes
variant_definitions.semantic_classwise: per-semantic-class normalized Gaussian fields with all-hit robust scale
variant_definitions.semantic_core_scale_classwise: oracle core-only robust scale plus per-semantic-class normalized Gaussian fields
variant_definitions.semantic_bim_replace_nonedge: all-hit robust scale, but replace oracle core/non-edge pixels by rendered BIM depth
variant_definitions.semantic_category_replace_nonedge: replace only where oracle image class equals the rendered BIM component class
variant_definitions.semantic_category_replace_asymmetric: category-matched replacement rejected only when BIM is >0.10 log-depth behind scaled DA3
variant_definitions.semantic_category_replace_consistent: category-matched replacement additionally requiring the frozen 0.10 log-consistency gate
variant_definitions.semantic_category_soft_blend: category-matched, non-edge log-depth blend with a frozen Gaussian consistency weight

subset_definitions.all: all official valid z-depth pixels in [0.2, 5.0] m
subset_definitions.core_structure_bim_hit: core_structure & valid rendered BIM ray hit
subset_definitions.door_window: all & semantic in door/window, which the fixed core BIM excludes
subset_definitions.non_structural: all & known semantic outside the five BIM-supported core classes
subset_definitions.bim_foreground_conflict: all & BIM hit & GT < BIM-max(0.10m, 5% BIM)
subset_definitions.semantic_boundary: all & 3x3 morphological boundary of the semantic class map
